ld.name: Soho Sneaker With Crystal Signature
ld.description: Our Coach Soho Sneaker is inspired by the courageous free spirit of our hometown New York City and built to keep pace with life on the go. Crafted of denim embellished with our shimmery crystal Signature, it features a lining made with 100% recycled polyester and a midsole that contains at least 28% bio-based content, created through a process that uses renewable sources in place of fossil-based. The comfortable style is finished with a grooved rubber outsole detailed with a map of Manhattan.
